Issue: Website is being used as a lead source instead of a lead channel
Recommended Fix: Separate source (where lead came from) from contact method (how they reached out). Website = contact path, not source
Dependency: Need staff re-training and form/CRM update
Impact: Lead source data is mixed with contact method, source attribution is inaccurate
Next Step: Finalize field definitions and update lead sheet

Issue: Lead source and contact method are combined in single field causing attribution errors
Recommended Fix: Create separate Lead Source field and Contact Method field. Simplify values. Train staff.
Dependency: Need staff adoption and form update
Impact: Cannot accurately attribute leads to marketing channel, data is unreliable
Next Step: Share simplified field list with marina team

Recommended Fix: Create registration or interest form with source fields, use UTMs on email/social links, use QR or vanity URL on flyer, and maintain confirmed attendee sheet
Dependency: Registration path and attendee sheet must be created
Impact: Without a defined registration and source process, sign-ups may be captured but marketing source and event status will be hard to report
Next Step: Create registration path and confirmed attendee sheet before July 15
